description: Data-driven assessment of Apulian road network resilience: bridge unavailability and inner municipality isolation impact is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Niloofar Kheirkhahan. Road networks carry resources and passengers and connect supply chains. In seismically active areas like Italy, earthquakes can compromise road infrastructure, leading to structural failures and connectivity disruptions. Bridges, used for travel and emergency response, are especially vulnerable to these extreme events, so maintenance and recovery help preserve transport efficiency. Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 241356805 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
